title: AI SDLC repository profile
description: The checks one person runs on one repository. Lives under repos["owner/name"] in that person's machine profile and is never written into the repository. Holds names and commands only, never credentials.

gates.description: Checks that must pass before a pull request opens. A command string makes the gate required; null means the owner decided it is not required. {files} is replaced with the changed production files.

requiredPipelines.description: CI pipelines that must succeed on the pull request head before it is reported ready.

reviewBot.description: Automated PR reviewer to iterate with after the pull request opens.

specDir.description: Where the approved spec is committed. null keeps the spec out of the repository and puts it in the pull request description instead.

crossModelReviewAuthorized.description: Set false to forbid sending this repository's plans and code to additional model providers, whatever the machine profile says.
